quote_sanitization.description: Grep patterns capture surrounding quotes literally. Buscar en código "agent_kernel_v2" -> pattern = "agent_kernel_v2" (with quotes). Need to strip quotes.

endpoint_path_normalization.description: Route probe captures /v2/agent/status as-is. Need to prepend http://127.0.0.1:8091 for paths starting with /v2/.

indirect_file_reference.description: 'Leer el archivo donde esté NativeAgentRuntimeV2' captures literal path 'donde esté NativeAgentRuntimeV2'. Should be treated as indirect reference, not literal file_read.
indirect_file_reference.decision: For now, document as future enhancement. If file_read path contains spaces or Spanish words like 'donde', skip or treat as grep_search instead.

spanish_final_answer_obligation.description: FINAL_ANSWER_MARKERS only has English patterns. Spanish 'En la respuesta final...' not detected.

fix_plan: Strip surrounding quotes from all grep_search captured patterns
Normalize endpoint paths starting with /v2/ to http://127.0.0.1:8091 + path
Skip file_read if captured path contains spaces or looks like prose (indirect reference)
Add Spanish final answer obligation markers
